# redact-counts

mask_numbers(text, count=0) replaces each non-overlapping run matched by r"\d+" with "#", and returns the exact two-item result defined by re.subn. Forward the nonnegative count argument, including its default meaning. Keep the interface.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/3.12/Lib/re/__init__.py
Run: `python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests`. Keep the public interface and original tests. Standard library/built-ins only; no network or git in application code. Runtime artifacts belong in the system temporary directory.
